notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
Today a small update or even a big upgrade for performance. 

Some textures and effects have been reworked, which ensures that the overall performance is improved. 

The performance of the colorful meadow (terrain after the cave) has been improved. 
Here, up to 300% more fps can be achieved than before.

In addition, the bug has been fixed that the position of the character is stored incorrectly when he logs out while sitting in a vehicle.

notes.title: Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
The first patch of the year focuses on some visual and performance improvements. 

In a first revision of the build menu, all images have been replaced so that you can better see what you are actually building. 
The particles have been dusted off and now require less power.
On the low and mid graphic settings, the way all objects are loaded has been improved, which reduces vram consumption without any visual compromises.



Patch Notes

New Building Menu Icons:
The building menu has been updated with new icons, making it much easier to see what you're about to construct.

Enhanced Beach Atmosphere:
Added new particle effects to the beach area, making it feel more lively and immersive.

Performance Improvements:
Optimized particle effects to improve overall performance. 
(You may have to set your graphics settings in the game, not in the main menu, once, from e.g. high to low or on to off and back)
Reduced VRAM usage on low and mid-quality settings by approximately 15%, allowing for better performance in cases where VRAM is a bottleneck.
This optimization can also enhance loading times from storage, reduce RAM usage, and improve CPU efficiency—leading to smoother gameplay on lower-end systems.

Collision Fixes:
Improved colliders to prevent falling through the world and getting stuck inside buildings.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed various timers to ensure pets continue functioning properly. Previously, they could stop working in rare cases when browsing shops on high-quality settings.

Gameplay Tweaks:
Increased run speed by 20%, allowing for faster movement across the world.


Enjoy the update, and as always, let me know if you find any issues!

notes.title: Holiday Update & Engine Upgrade
notes.content:
Patch Notes

[Upgrade to Unity Engine 6]
The game has been upgraded to the new Unity Engine 6, bringing numerous improvements in performance, stability, networking, and visual quality. Please note that on the first launch after the update, all textures may appear blue for a brief moment while the shaders update. This process typically takes just a few seconds.

[Vehicle Improvements]
Vehicle physics have been slightly reworked to allow for smoother and more enjoyable handling. Additional improvements are already planned and will be coming in future updates.

[Festive Cheer! 🎄]
The holiday season has arrived! Festive decorations have been added to match the current season. Decorate your world with Christmas trees and other holiday-themed items to set the perfect festive mood.

[More Decoration]
Added some inner decoration parts in modern style.

[Lighting Optimizations]
Most point lights have been replaced with spotlights, delivering more realistic lighting and better overall performance. Your farm will now shine brighter and more beautifully than ever!

[Overhauled Server and Game Creation]
Server and game creation processes have been reworked, which may result in slightly longer loading times depending on the number of buildings and decorations in your world.
The benefit: This change resolves issues where characters would spawn stuck in foundations or in undesired locations.


[Known Issues:]

If you log out or exit the game while seated in a vehicle, your current position will not be saved. Upon rejoining, you will respawn at a safespot, and your character may require an "unstuck" action.


[Looking Ahead to the New Year 🎉]
With this update, I’ll be wrapping up development for the year—unless any critical bugs arise. I want to thank all of you for your support the year. I’m excited to bring you more updates, content, and surprises in the upcoming year!

Until then, I wish you and your loved ones a Merry Christmas, a relaxing holiday season, and a fantastic New Year! 🎅🎄

notes.title: The Beach Update
notes.content:
It's Time to Grab Your Beachwear – The Beach Update is Here!

The Beach Update has arrived, bringing a wave of new content, improvements, and bug fixes! Get ready to build your dream beachside paradise and explore the sunny shores. Here’s what’s new and improved:


Bug Fixes:

Fixed: Mouse cursor now stays hidden while in build mode, giving you a smoother experience.

Fixed: The "Connect" button is no longer interactable after entering an incorrect lobby ID.

Fixed: Global illumination is now properly applied to all objects, enhancing the game’s lighting consistency.

Fixed: Corrected light layers on various objects, improving visual accuracy.

Fixed: Added missing text strings for a more complete interface.


New Additions:

New: Beach Area: A beautiful new beach area with plenty of space to build and relax by the ocean. Set up your beachside retreat right next to your home!

New: Beach Building Set: This new building set has a weathered and wave-worn look, perfect for crafting coastal structures.

New: Decorations Galore: A variety of new decoration items, mostly in a beach style, are now available to add even more charm to your surroundings.

New: Player Position Save: Your last position is now saved upon logout, so you’ll rejoin the game right where you left off.


Improvements:

Enhanced Skybox Shader: Enjoy a more vibrant and dynamic sky with improved shaders that bring more depth and color.

Clearer Clouds: Clouds are now more visible and defined, adding atmosphere to the skies.

Sun Shader Upgrade: The sun is now more realistic and intense, so don’t forget your virtual sunscreen!

Dynamic Lighting: Adjusted the brightness of the directional light throughout the day and night. If you prefer a brighter world, you can toggle the “Brighter World” setting in the config menu.

Improved Ground Textures: Several ground textures have been enhanced to look more detailed.

Increased Draw Distance: Maximum draw distance for ground textures has been increased, providing more depth to distant landscapes without a heavy performance impact.


Get Ready to Make Waves! Dive into the Beach Update today and start creating your ideal beachside sanctuary. With new building options, decorations, and environmental upgrades, there’s so much to explore and enjoy. Happy building!

notes.title: Patch 101
notes.content:
Patch 101

The first patch tweaks the performance, UI and other annoying bugs here and there.

fixed: Placement of some objects (flying trees etc.).
fixed: You get the wrong achievement when entering the mine.
fixed: Playback of the sounds of footsteps.
fixed: Birdsong can also be heard in the mine.
fixed: The range of the sounds from the cat.
fixed: Vehicles spawn in wrong rotation after re-entering the world.

new: In the sales shop, all products that are in the warehouse are now displayed.
new: A fullscreen window option has been added to the settings.

Improved: Windows can now be closed with ESC.
Improved: Improved the performance of the terrain after the mine.
Improved: Performance in general has been improved.
Improved: Improved the animation and function of the hoe and made harvesting smoother.


Known bugs: 

*If a cat is in the game as a char, subsequent players will spawn in the ground (Using the Unstuck feature fixes the bug until rejoining the game).

*After joining a game from the Steam Friends List, it may appear in some cases that there is no response (if there are connection issues or on weak hardware, it may take up to a minute to establish or deny the connection)
